rules.condition: A protected work, mark, product, or software item is paired with current unauthorized copying, distribution, public performance, access, or counterfeit sale evidence.
Ownership, authorization, licence scope, jurisdiction, provenance, or a legal limitation or exception is unresolved while plausible rights-impacting conduct is present.
Authorization, ownership, compatible licence, public-domain status, or official distribution is established and no contrary evidence is present.

Criticism, comment, news reporting, teaching, scholarship, research, quotation, parody, preservation, and accessibility are protected from automatic infringement conclusions; unresolved legal scope is reviewed.
A title, logo, visual style, similarity, watermark, allegation, or self-reported ownership claim alone is not enough to establish infringement.
The component cannot determine ownership, licence validity, legal exceptions, jurisdiction, or infringement from appearance or an LLM, and it cannot issue an automatic takedown.

source_boundary.note: Sources define routing guardrails, not machine-verifiable legal outcomes. Local law and facts control.
